title: Tour 1 — Session Context & Access Import
description: Explore the left Session Context bar (replacing legacy Data Centre) and see how .accdb/.mdb projects import into SQLite WAL.

steps.title: Persistent Session Context Bar
steps.body: Replaces the floating VPro 64 Data Centre. Your active Project, Site Unit (*_SU), Hierarchy, and Lump tables stay visible and cryptographically scoped.

steps.title: Project Admin & Access .accdb/.mdb Import
steps.body: Create projects, run 3-way merges, OptimizeVeg, or import legacy Access VP05–VP08 databases with full FK orphan quarantine.

steps.title: Open Scientific Interchange Hub
steps.body: Exchange data cleanly with VENUS 5.0 XML, TurboVeg 3, GeoPackage (BC Albers EPSG:3005), CSV matrices, and R .rds.

title: Tour 2 — Fast FS882 Card & Datasheet Entry
description: Navigate FS882, Two-Page, SIVI, LMH25 live rules, CHARS shrub layer toggle, and the virtualized 9-table Datasheet Grid.

steps.title: FS882 Ecological Field Card
steps.body: Enter Site, Soil, and Vegetation strata with Enter-key subgrid navigation, IEEE-754 SINGLE cover calibration, and F1 contextual LMH25 help on any field.

steps.title: Virtualized 9-Table Datasheet Grid
steps.body: Inspect and batch-edit _Env, _Veg, _Humus, _Mineral, _Audit, and *_SU with TSV clipboard paste and atomic audit trail.

title: Tour 3 — Classification Explorer & Taxon Lumping
description: Manage Site Unit (*_SU) assignments, 12-level Hierarchies with ~ breakpoints, and versioned *_Lump species recipes.

steps.title: Dual-Pane SU & Hierarchy Explorer
steps.body: Assign plots across Site Units, synchronize SU <-> Env, and organize 12-level classification trees with ~ report breakpoints.

steps.title: Taxon Lumping (*_Lump) & Recipes
steps.body: Build repeatable species lumping tables for regional synthesis without mutating raw field plot codes.

title: Tour 4 — 3D Geospatial QA, BEC Diagnostics & Reports
description: Audit BGC v13 plot coordinates on the 3D MapLibre/WebGPU globe, run live BEC Differential Synthesis, and export .xlsx / Quarto guides.

steps.title: 3D MapLibre + WebGPU Geospatial Workbench
steps.body: Stream provincial BGC v13 & Ecosection PMTiles offline, run Point-in-Polygon spatial QA, and lasso plots directly into *_SU units.

steps.title: Reactive BEC Differential & Pairwise Synthesis
steps.body: Inspect Presence Class, Differential Value (d1–d3, dd1–dd4), and Cramér similarity with < 10 ms live plot reassignment and 4-sheet .xlsx export.

steps.title: R Sidecar: climr aSMR, Clustering & Quarto Guides
steps.body: Downscale climate normals into __VPRO_PlotClimate, compare rSMR vs. aSMR grids, run vegan/vegclust candidate clustering, and publish Quarto unit guides.
